body: U+0023# How to work this threadU+000AU+000ARead this before planning. It is the operating contract, not background.U+000AU+000AU+0023## First action, before anything elseU+000AU+000AThe SPEC exists only in a session scratchpad and dies with the session that wrote it. Copy it into the repo first:U+000AU+000AU+0060``U+000A/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-satanshumishra-Documents-DevLabs--windful-ocean/9b619061-27ab-4ffb-b421-7f26e72d1743/scratchpad/SPEC-agent-architecture-remediation.mdU+000AU+0060``U+000AU+000ACut a branch off `chore/remove-v1-file-ledger` (never commit to main), land the SPEC under `docs/`, commit. Only then plan.U+000AU+000AU+0023## The SPEC is the source of truth, and it is a ceilingU+000AU+000ABuild what it specifies. If it is wrong or unimplementable, say so and stop — do not work around it and do not invent scope it does not name. Its own open questions are not pending work.U+000AU+000AU+0023## Apply in section 9's order, and do not reorder itU+000AU+000AThe order is chosen so no window exists where enforcement is absent. Mechanisms go in before any prose changes; the mechanism tests pass before anything is deleted; the preamble shrinks last. Specifically:U+000AU+000A1U+002E Transitional deny rules (§6.5) stop the nine outgoing agents being dispatched.U+000A2U+002E Depth limit and hooks (§6.1, §6.3, §6.4).U+000A3U+002E **Verify 8.10-8.12 before deleting anything.**U+000A4U+002E Create the four skills (§4).U+000A5U+002E Write `machinist`; rewrite the four retained agents (§3.4) with entry invariants (§6.2).U+000A6U+002E Verify 8.9 and 8.13.U+000A7U+002E Delete the nine outgoing agent files.U+000A8U+002E Rule dispositions and the delegation replacement (§5.2, §5.3).U+000A9U+002E Remove the transitional deny rules.U+000A10U+002E Run all of §8.U+000AU+000AU+0023## Work in a terminal CLI session, not the desktop appU+000AU+000AFork is available at `entrypoint: cli` and absent at `entrypoint: claude-desktop`. Self-test: if the Agent tool exposes `run_in_background`, fork mode is off. Several acceptance checks depend on fork-adjacent behaviour.U+000AU+000AU+0023## Restart before verifying anything you just wroteU+000AU+000AAn agent definition edit does not reach a dispatch made in the same session. Criteria 9, 10 and 11 dispatch agents this work will have just written, so restart between writing and verifying or the check tests the previous definition. Settings and hooks also resolve at session start, so step 2 above requires a restart before step 3.U+000AU+000AU+0023## Use the architecture while building itU+000AU+000AThis thread's own work should demonstrate the decisions it implements, not contradict them:U+000AU+000AU+002D **Do the work in the main thread.** Delegation needs one of the four named reasons. Editing a rule file is not one of them.U+000AU+002D **Never write a hold loop.** A dispatched agent's result arrives on its own; end the turn.U+000AU+002D **Never read a `tasks/*.output` file.** That is the pathology the hooks exist to block.U+000AU+002D **Never assert a harness capability** in anything you write. That is the root cause.U+000AU+002D **Every gate you author asserts a categorical property.** A threshold is permitted only as a circuit breaker with its measured basis stated beside it.U+000AU+000AU+0023## Public repo, confidential identifierU+000AU+000AU+0060.windful-ocean` is public and the logbook ledger is pushed to a `_ledger` branch on its origin. The project the incident happened on has a confidential codename that appears in transcript paths. It must never reach a tracked file, a decision record, a session entry or an artifact pointer. Refer to the incident only as session `cfdbeee9`.U+000AU+000AU+0023## Do not re-derive the measurementsU+000AU+000AEvery figure in the SPEC was measured from the transcripts and is recorded. Re-measuring adds a second error source rather than confidence. If a figure looks wrong, say which one and why, and stop.U+000AU+000AU+0023## What "done" meansU+000AU+000AThe twelve completion criteria on this thread are all `proposed` — derived, not confirmed by the human. Ask which ones they stand behind before treating any as settled. Criteria 6 through 11 are the ones that matter: they test mechanisms. The rest test arrangement.U+000AU+000ACriterion 12 (`/skill-doctor` before and after) must have its **before** reading captured at the start, or it cannot be satisfied later.U+000A
